aggregate_scope: Fresh AI-authored confirmation of a method selected on separate reused-source diagnostics. This is not human-verified workplace gold or an operational risk estimate.
cost_interpretation: Request wall time includes local parsing and execution validation; preparation costs are measured separately. Snapshot compilation counts only actual compilations, excluding cached zero-cost entries. Shared-host measurements are descriptive, not service-load SLOs.
inference_unit: case; shared documents, semantic families and conditions are not independent samples
limitations: All decisions are evaluation-only shadow observations with execution_authority=none; no action is executed.
Production conditions retain the unchanged production occurrence guard; shadow conditions separately test source support without granting production authorization.
Source facts and labels are AI authored and independently AI reviewed, not human gold or actual workplace records.
Missing applicability values remain UNKNOWN and are never inferred to be true.
Ownership uses known glossary spellings and a bounded nearest-mention discourse rule; it is not semantic entailment.
All conditions retain complete source text and complete candidate definitions; only evidence policy and experimental judgment differ.
Candidate retrieval and occurrence binding are produced by the actual resolver; gold is used only for scoring.
Family clusters are statistical units; reused diagnostic sources are not an independent validation population.
The paragraph baseline includes the new source-ownership and explicit-conflict checks; it is not numerically interchangeable with the preceding bundle-control baseline.
metric_interpretation: Raw semantic selection and occurrence-bound approval are separate; synthetic/public proxy samples do not certify deployment risk.
proposal_interpretation: Production conditions retain the unchanged occurrence authorization guard. Shadow conditions report EXPERIMENTAL_SIMULATED_APPROVAL only and grant no execution authority. Raw model proposals, production guard results and shadow decisions remain separate.
unknown_attribute_interpretation: Unknown-attribute counts describe absent selected supporting claims. Null proposals leave every attribute UNKNOWN; these counts do not establish that the source lacks the attribute, or that an unstated attribute is false.
